purpose: Post-result diagnostic, not primary preregistered experiment. Audit cross-seed mask sensitivity and compare learned camera against mean training-camera output.
global_mask: For each of 3 evaluation frames, intersect all 5 seeds and all 10 primary methods plus 2 diagnostic controls. No retraining or selection by evaluation results.
controls: risk+fixed-camera: use mean eta/shift on the FOUR TRAIN frames of the same seed's final learned model. risk+camera-oldK: same image/depth reprojection geometry, but disparity conversion uses original fx. Both reported separately.
limits: Extremely conservative shared-mask subset; coverage and valid pixel counts must accompany all errors. Primary per-seed common-mask results remain unchanged.
